entries.zh: 臺；烛台的承座（candeleros 条下的单字〝臺〞，下承〝cheng hen〞疑即〝撑核/承座〞类字）；高台
entries.en: stand, pedestal; the base part of a candlestick (given with a second character reading cheng hen); raised platform
entries.notes: source_R 〝cheng hen tǎy〞两字残缺难定，仅〝臺/tǎy〞四栏互证清晰，故降中。

entries.zh: 灯；油灯（candil 为 17 世纪西班牙语〝油灯、风灯〞，非现代〝照明〞泛义）
entries.en: lamp, oil lamp (17th-c. candil: a portable or hanging oil lamp)
lamplight; lamp and fire, the light of the lamp

entries.zh: 灯台（candileja con hoz 之〝hoz〞疑为灯上的叉/钩状托件，即灯台上安灯的部分）
entries.en: lampstand; the stand part of the candil (its hook-like holder), on which the lamp is set
entries.notes: 西语词头〝con hoz, o a en el candil〞拼写残乱（hoz=钩、o a 疑为脱落字），释义以汉字〝灯臺〞与四栏对音为准。

entries.zh: 灯花（灯芯燃烧所结之花）；灯焰
entries.en: snuff, the charred wick-flower of a burning lamp; lamp flame

entries.zh: 桂皮；桂（肉桂，马尼拉贸易中的香料与药材）
entries.en: cinnamon; cassia bark, a trade spice and drug of the Manila galleon traffic

entries.zh: 蟳；膏蟹（青蟳，闽地习食之大蟹）
entries.en: mud crab (Scylla), the large edible crab prized in Fujian; commercial crab

entries.zh: 小蟹；蟹（单字〝螃〞，对音 pon òa 含〝蟹〞音，指螃蟹类小蟹）
entries.en: small crabs; crab (single character 螃, with the reading pon-oa 'crab')
entries.notes: 汉字仅出〝螃〞一字，〝蟹〞义依 source_M 之 òa 与西语 pequeños 推得，降中。

entries.zh: 蠘膏；膏蠘（有膏的梭子蟹类，〝蠘〞为闽语刺蟹/花蟹通称）
entries.en: roe-bearing swimming crab; the 〝chhe〞 crab with fat/roe inside (chhe = Min term for swimming/pointed crabs)
entries.notes: 西语词头〝pin cados〞拼写残乱（疑 pinçados/pintados 类讹写），释义以汉字〝蠘膏〞与对音 chy cò 为准。

entries.zh: 瘦蟳；不肥之蟹（西语 bacios, flacos＝空瘪、瘦，指无膏不肥之蟳）
entries.en: thin, empty (not fat) crabs; crabs lacking roe/flesh (Span. bacios 'empty', flacos 'lean')
entries.notes: 汉字〝蟳有〞残缺（疑〝蟳芭〞或后接字脱落），西语词头语义明确而汉字栏不全，降中。

entries.zh: 钳坚齿利的蟳（西语谓有硬钳尖齿之蟹）；大钳蟳
entries.en: crabs with hard pincers and pointed teeth (as the Spanish gloss says); strong-clawed crab
entries.notes: 汉字〝有蟳〞与西语〝peg cañtos dientes〞（pelludos/puntiagudos dentes 类讹写）皆存疑，对音 těng chīm/gūin chīm 互有出入，降中。

entries.zh: 大暑（二十四节气之大暑，天最热时节；canicularis＝三伏酷热天）
entries.en: the Great Heat, canicular (dog) days, the hottest period of the year
entries.notes: 汉字第二字[疑:暑/署]，依 canicularis 与对音 tā sy 定为〝暑〞。

entries.zh: 床簀；床上的竹簀/苇席（canico 疑为 cañico＝苇秆、芦竹，即铺床之簀席）
entries.en: bed matting, a reed/cane lattice laid on a bed (canico, prob. cañico = reed, cane)
entries.notes: 西语词头拼写存疑（canico 非 17 世纪常见词形，疑 cañico 缩夺鼻音符），释义依汉字〝床簀〞与对音 chung te 为准。

entries.zh: 床簀；床上的竹簀/苇席（与上条同词同义重出）
entries.en: bed matting, a reed/cane lattice laid on a bed (repeat of the preceding entry)
entries.notes: 与 position 15 四栏全同，词典原稿重出条。
